t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The previous player explored many possible rules, but stated that higher hats do not equal higher amounts of mushrooms. They stated that they tried selecting the gnome whose hat was the closest to the basket, but it did not seem to be a rule, and selecting in the order of the rainbow did not work since the colors that appear are randomized. Overall, they stated that there did not seem to be any rules and to select the gnomes as quickly as possible.

vb_textbox.text: The previous participant stated that hat size doesn't matter, neither do color schemes. For example, a gnome with a taller hat will not yield more mushrooms. Selecting a gnome that was close to the color of the previous basket will not always yield more mushrooms, so it is probably not a rule. Following a rainbow color pattern is not possible and is likely not a rule. There are pairs of gnomes that will come up often, such as purple/brown and blue/green. I tried to explore if there were any special sequences to selecting these gnomes, but it does not seem to be the case. I also tried selecting patterns of left/right after certain basket colors, which does not seem to be a rule. After all of the rounds, I was not able to find any rules to the game that would always yield higher mushrooms. Something to note is that the basket colors come after you select a gnome color, which makes me think it has something to do with the gnome pairs and not the basket color or forest background. But I honestly don't know and would recommend you to explore, these are just the things I've tried. The only thing I can suggest is to always select your gnome and basket quickly for each round or you won't get any mushrooms at all.
